CURRENT leaves the existing flow fully unaffected. STALE triggers a targeted retrieval keyed on the pointer's own real 'phase' field (an exact structural match, chosen only after confirming E9's capability_refs are unrelated bootstrap artifacts and not a usable key), filtered to real corrects_experience_id links, followed by an independent exact-key re-verification of the corrected Experience and an evidence/SHA bridge attempt against its real original evidence. cause.root_cause_summary: PHASE-E25's pointerCurrencyGuard() was a real, general, reusable detector but was itself a one-off phase-materialization script, never re-invoked after its single run -- its own general logic simply had never been wired to fire again, exactly mirroring the 942/946 case.

lesson: The 942/946 re-arm architecture generalizes beyond its origin case: a second, independently-evidenced dormant detector (pointerCurrencyGuard) was re-armed with the same technique, but the correct correction-linking key had to be independently re-derived per error class -- capability_ref worked for 942/946, but E9's capability_refs were unrelated bootstrap artifacts, and the real structural link here was the pointer's own 'phase' field matching the correction Experience's 'phase' field instead.
